# Test default and explicit GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo selection under go and logos.
# Under plain go, logosfastcgo defaults to off; under logos, it defaults to on.
# Explicit GOEXPERIMENT settings (opt-in, opt-out, none, token order, GOENV) win.

[!cgo] skip

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOENV=$WORK/isolated.env

# 1. Plain go with default settings: logosfastcgo is off.
env GOEXPERIMENT=
go build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-off$'

# 2. Plain go with explicit opt-in: logosfastcgo is on.
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo
go build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-on$'

# 3. logos with explicit opt-in: logosfastcgo is on.
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-on$'

# 4. Plain go-off check after logos-on: guards reverse reuse from the build cache.
env GOEXPERIMENT=
go build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-off$'

# 5. logos with explicit opt-out: nologosfastcgo wins and turns it off.
env GOEXPERIMENT=nologosfastcgo
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-off$'

# 6. logos with explicit none: none turns all experiments off.
env GOEXPERIMENT=none
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-off$'

# 7. Token-order cases under logos: later tokens win, none clears preceding tokens.
# 7a. opt-in followed by opt-out: off.
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo,nologosfastcgo
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-off$'

# 7b. opt-out followed by opt-in: on.
env GOEXPERIMENT=nologosfastcgo,logosfastcgo
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-on$'

# 7c. none followed by opt-in: on.
env GOEXPERIMENT=none,logosfastcgo
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-on$'

# 7d. opt-in followed by none: off.
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo,none
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-off$'

# 8. Isolated GOENV file choices: configuration file wins when process env is unset.
env GOEXPERIMENT=

# 8a. Explicit opt-in in GOENV file under plain go: on.
go env -w GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo
go build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-on$'

# 8b. Explicit opt-out in GOENV file under logos: off.
go env -w GOEXPERIMENT=nologosfastcgo
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-off$'

# 8c. Explicit none in GOENV file under logos: off.
go env -w GOEXPERIMENT=none
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-off$'

# Clean up GOENV file setting.
go env -u GOEXPERIMENT

# 9. logos with no explicit setting: defaults to on.
env GOEXPERIMENT=
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-on$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/fastcgotest

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

/*
#cgo noescape add
#cgo nocallback add
int add(int a, int b) {
	return a + b;
}
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() {
	sum := int(C.add(C.int(40), C.int(2)))
	fmt.Printf("sum%d mode=%s\n", sum, mode)
}

-- mode_off.go --
//go:build !goexperiment.logosfastcgo

package main

const mode = "fastcgo-off"

-- mode_on.go --
//go:build goexperiment.logosfastcgo

package main

const mode = "fastcgo-on"
